title: Implementation of Boolean Function in SOP and POS Form Using Multisim

questions.q: What is the difference between a minterm and a maxterm?
questions.a: A minterm is an AND product term of all variables that equals 1 for a single input combination, whereas a maxterm is an OR sum term of all variables that equals 0 for a single input combination.

questions.q: Why are variables with value 1 complemented in a maxterm (POS) but uncomplemented in a minterm (SOP)?
questions.a: Because a minterm (AND) needs all inputs to be 1 to output 1, while a maxterm (OR) needs all inputs to be 0 to output 0.

questions.q: How can `A'B'C + A'BC + ABC'` in Experiment 9 be simplified algebraically?
questions.a: Factor `A'C` from the first two terms: `A'C(B' + B) + ABC' = A'C(1) + ABC' = A'C + ABC'`.

questions.q: What two-level gate structure implements an SOP expression?
questions.a: A first level of AND gates (producing the product terms) feeding a second-level OR gate (summing the products).

questions.q: If a 3-variable function has minterms Sigma_m(1, 3, 6), what are its maxterms?
How do you evaluate `XSOP = A'B'C + A'BC + ABC'` for all 8 states in Python?
questions.a: Loop `for i in range(8): A, B, C = (i>>2)&1, (i>>1)&1, i&1; Y = int(((not A) and (not B) and C) or ((not A) and B and C) or (A and B and (not C)))`.

questions.q: What two-level gate structure implements a POS expression?
questions.a: A first level of OR gates (forming the sum terms) feeding a second-level AND gate.

questions.q: Evaluate Y for (A=1, B=1, C=0) and (A=1, B=1, C=1) in Experiment 9.
questions.a: For (1,1,0) [m6], ABC' = 1·1·1 = 1 so Y = 1. For (1,1,1) [m7], all minterms are 0 so Y = 0.

questions.q: If the SOP circuit outputs 1 for (0,1,0) instead of (1,1,0), what wiring error occurred?
questions.a: Input A on the third AND gate was accidentally connected to A' instead of A.

questions.q: How many 1s and how many 0s appear in the output column of Experiment 9?
questions.a: Three 1s (at m1, m3, m6) and five 0s (at m0, m2, m4, m5, m7).
